title: Gold Plus: Exclusive perks and features
summary: Gold Plus provides a 25% discount on Rho-Bank brokerage trading commissions, includes cryptocurrency trading access, and allows linking up to 4 family member accounts for shared benefits within one household. Perks are activated from the investment dashboard after account verification, crypto access is confirmed in trading preferences, and family members are added via profile with account details.
